quantity: synaptic reversal potential (local, at the PSI contact)
requires: A recording site electrically compact with the synapse, OR an independent correction for the somatic-to-synaptic attenuation. The observed zero-crossing is a SOMATIC apparent reversal, pulled toward resting potential by passive filtering.
confounded_with: Cable filtering between the synapse and the clamp site; the unknown contact->soma path (B-5).
current_freeze_status: NOT IN REGISTRY as a local synaptic value
gate_consequence: A somatic series bounds E_rev; it does not measure it.

requires: A multi-point amplitude-vs-holding-potential series with adequate clamp quality. Identifiable WITHOUT cable knowledge, but only as the somatic apparent value.
confounded_with: Anything that makes the somatic apparent value differ from the local E_rev.
current_freeze_status: NOT IN REGISTRY (derived quantity, not measured)
gate_consequence: Usable as an upper/lower constraint on E_rev, explicitly labelled apparent.

requires: The series gives I_somatic(V_hold). Its shape is the local I-V convolved with the somatic transfer function, so only the zero crossing is robust.
gate_consequence: Cannot be presented as the synaptic I-V.

quantity: peak synaptic conductance at the contact
requires: A local recording. From a somatic clamp, g_syn = I_peak/(V_hold - E_rev) yields the SOMATIC apparent conductance, already multiplied by the attenuation factor.
confounded_with: The attenuation factor, i.e. Ra/Rm/Cm and the contact->soma path.
gate_consequence: Extracting g_syn somatically assumes the answer.

quantity: synaptic conductance independent of spatial attenuation
requires: Nothing available in a somatic series. The attenuation and the conductance are not separable from one another at one recording site.
gate_consequence: This is the core reason a reversal series cannot touch B-4.

requires: A local recording. Somatically the time course is the synaptic waveform filtered by the cable, so rise/decay are not the synaptic values.
confounded_with: Cable time constant; this is why no EPSP kinetics exist in the freeze.
gate_consequence: No kinetic value may be reported from this design.

quantity: driving force (V_m - E_rev) at the contact
requires: Requires both the local synaptic V_m and the local E_rev. A somatic series supplies neither at the contact.
confounded_with: Local membrane potential at the synapse.
gate_consequence: The single-point EPSP/driving-force route is unavailable.

requires: Separate miniature-recording experiment at the same site; not part of a reversal series.
gate_consequence: Separate blocker, untouched by this design.

requires: Failure analysis plus mEPSP amplitude at a defined site; the release sites are in the peripheral nerve, not the soma.
EM of the contact; no electrophysiological design can yield it.
EM receptor-crowding analysis or calibrated binding.
Single-channel recording in a native preparation, or an independent constraint. No native Drosophila value exists.
gate_consequence: Not addressed by any somatic series.

quantity: PSI->MN5 contact->soma spatial voltage transfer ratio
requires: Dual-site or optical voltage measurement. A single-site reversal series cannot produce a transfer ratio.
gate_consequence: GATE 1 stays closed; this is blocker B-4, untouched here.

requires: Two-site current injection at >=3 known locations plus known geometry, with identifiability demonstrated. Two sites constrain only the combination of Ra and Rm.
Separate measurement. The two non-MN5 sources already differ by 4.4x, so no defensible bound exists to sweep over.
Nothing. Cm is 43 +/- 2 pF versus 127 +/- 16 pF (C-01); a reversal series does not adjudicate it.
confounded_with: Space clamp; series resistance; bridge balance.
gate_consequence: Contest must not be resolved by choosing a value.

requires: Direct receptor identification. Current support is genetic inference (allele strength vs EPSP amplitude) with a rescue driver that is not localised to MN5.
confounded_with: Everything: identity is inferred, not observed at this synapse.
gate_consequence: A reversal series measures the RESPONSE, not the receptor. GATE 2 untouched.

quantity: input/output specificity (is the response from PSI?)
requires: Direct PSI stimulation plus controls: PSI is a MINORITY input - 17 of 10,529 synapses on 801970 (0.16 percent) and 26 of 11,260 on 801295 (0.23 percent), with 887 and 897 DISTINCT presynaptic bodies converging on each MN5 and the largest single partner contributing 118-168 synapses.
confounded_with: Polysynaptic recruitment; other presynaptic neurons; muscle feedback.
gate_consequence: Achievable, but the specificity burden is large.
